proposal.name: 2基の制御装置を起動

board.coordinates: A1 top left, K9 bottom right

legend.L: left device at D3; nontraversable objective cell
legend.R: right device at H3; nontraversable objective cell
legend.#: solid obstacle; cannot traverse, blocks ordinary line-of-sight (proposed)
legend.A: ally initial slot core-a at D8
legend.B: ally initial slot core-b at F8
legend.C: ally initial slot core-c at H8
legend.u: reserved R4 reinforcement spawn F2; traversable before spawn

tacticalIntent: Split party toward D3 and H3 instead of treating enemy elimination as the mission goal.
A central guard and walls E5/G5 make direct pathing and LOS nontrivial, but D5 and H5 remain traversable.
The third robot can choose between suppressing a gunner, clearing a path, and supporting a wounded activator.
Device cells themselves block occupation but not adjacent interaction; players may complete either device first.
board.collisionAndLOS: Use shared global movement/LOS and unit occupancy; no special mission bypass of weapons or collision

clock.successTrigger: after each allied interaction completes, when both devices are active and resolution finds no simultaneous defeat
clock.timeout: after all normal round-6 actions, if at least one device inactive, mission defeat
clock.subgoalTiming: based on round when second device activates, not on a separate timer or later outcome

interaction.lineOfSight: proposed: objective interaction requires only orthogonally adjacent cell; no attack LOS check needed
interaction.apply: mark specified device active atomically and log actingUnitId, roundNumber and deviceId

transitions.effect: invalid action; no cost or state mutation

stateMachine.invariant: device status never changes active -> inactive, including while allies die or respawn

defeat.predicate: no living allied robots && no legal pending allied respawn before or during round 6

precedence: If the second device is activated legally by a living robot, success is evaluated after the entire action and mandatory consequences.
No early-win for killing all enemies: advance time and allow remaining activation actions.
Last unit's destruction with respawn queued is not an immediate game over; the six-round limit still applies.
If no living ally and no pending legal respawn, immediate defeat is allowed rather than consuming inert rounds.

subobjective.name: 4ラウンド以内に2装置を起動

implementationState.invariant: an activation is associated with exactly one living acting unit and a unique device id

reinforcements.spawnEvent: at start of full round 4 before any ordinary actor actions
reinforcements.occupiedSpawnPolicy: first free traversable candidate; cannot overlap actor or device cell
reinforcements.ifAllBlocked: defer until start of next round, not after mission finished
reinforcements.actsInSpawnRound: normal initiative; no bonus immediate strike

enemySetup.enemyAiActions: normal movement/attack only; no free damage to devices; no permanent AI immunity

allyRespawn.conceptSource: early Easy M07 outline in missions.json indicates allyRespawn:true; specific policy below is proposed
allyRespawn.eligibleAtRound: deathRound+2 at beginning of the eligible full round
allyRespawn.placementByUnitId: use board.allyRespawnPads ordered candidates; choose first free traversable tile
allyRespawn.blockedPlacement: defer to next round until mission deadline; do not stack units or make a blocked tile free

onRespawn.hp: full effective maximum HP based on owned core/frame/parts; unchanged equipment

allyRespawn.mainObjectivePersistence: activated devices stay active when operator destroyed
allyRespawn.ifEntirePartyDestroyed: continue only while a valid pending respawn may occur during rounds 1..6; otherwise defeat
allyRespawn.notGuaranteedVictory: limited respawn does not extend 6-round limit, teleport an actor near a device, or automatically activate devices

enemyAI.baseline: M01 proposed deterministic legal move-and-attack AI, objective-aware in M07
globalPrinciples: Enemy prefers a legal attack on an allied unit who can activate an inactive device next, when attack can stop or threaten it.
Use nearest intercept positions around D3/H3; avoid wasting turns standing on inactive device cell (device cell nontraversable).
Gun unit prefers ranged clear LOS to one of the approach corridors; do not fire through walls.
After a device activates, prioritize remaining inactive device's approach or threat to the living activator.
If a legal lethal attack is available, it can outweigh abstract occupation score; do not intentionally miss or spare allied actors.
No hidden modifiers to enemy defense/attack or guaranteed successful player interactions.

unitRoles.raider-0: harass western device approach, force D4/D5 path tradeoffs
unitRoles.guard-0: durable threat at central approach F4, shift toward the side with more player attackers
unitRoles.gunner-0: control eastern approach from I4, relocate for LOS when necessary
unitRoles.raider-wave-4: arrive near top corridor F2 and pressure the remaining inactive device

enemyAI.deterministicTieBreak: use shared core actor/target/cell sort, pending global turn-order definition
requiresImplementedCore: respawn scheduling and atomic mission actions

obstacleOnlyManhattanSearch.definition: Shortest orthogonal walk distance to any walkable orthogonally adjacent device square; ignores occupants and move-type restrictions.

optimisticMinimumActivationPlan.caveat: Enemy attacks, unit blocking, restricted frame movement, initiative and exact interaction sequencing remain untested.

riskFactors: Enemy's 3 initial combat units can kill exposed operators using same baseline M01 attack/DEF math.
Four-round subgoal rewards efficient parallel movement, while six-round win allows a slower or recovery-oriented path.
Respawn has fixed cost in time and distance, and cannot activate either device automatically.
A wrong split or repeated lost turns can fail despite defeating multiple enemies.

unresolved: Exact 11x9 layout, 6-round main clock implementation, 4-round subgoal, R4 wave, and enemy pad are candidate tuning except the overall six/four-round concept already discussed.
Ally respawn is present in previous M07 outline; one-per-unit, deathRound+2 and ordered pads are candidate mechanics needing approval.
Device action orthogonal-adjacency rule, enemy AI interception, relative initiative, line-of-sight and collision require game-wide rule finalization.
Final device interaction action legality, late-round pending respawns, and defeat/tie resolution should be tested in executable core once implemented.
No valid-turn battle simulation or win-rate estimates were executed; current checks test only static map/reference integrity.
